verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a template gallery, starter templates, or browsing and forking community projects. The closest features are Import from GitHub, which starts from code already in a repository, and cloning pages from screenshots or Figma. Those are related ways to avoid a blank prompt, but they are not a template or community-project ecosystem, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt
